columns: changed_at timestamp with time zone NO default now()
constraints: boq_line_change_log_boq_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (boq_id) REFERENCES boq(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
boq_line_change_log_boq_line_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (boq_line_id) REFERENCES boq_line(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
boq_line_change_log_review_item_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (review_item_id) REFERENCES analysis_review_item(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

policies.name: boq_line_change_log owner read
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (boq b
     JOIN projects p ON ((p.id = b.project_id)))
  WHERE ((b.id = boq_line_change_log.boq_id) AND (p.owner_id = auth.uid()))))
